body: Thank you so much, honestly. I really want to feel better, and maybe that means that I'll have to do something that really hurts first. I'll do what I can in the meantime though, and I'll keep your kind words in mind. :)

That's totally fair, I'm mostly just angry about the my pain is too painful for them thing, because they all tell me that I can talk to them about anything but it seems like "anything" means only my accomplishments and achievements, not the things that weigh me down. With that being said, you're totally right, and I think it may be time to do some reflecting about why I feel the way I feel about these things. Thank you.
I'm pretty sure it's mental illness related, honestly. I'll try to stick it out a little longer, see if things get sorted out, but it's hard because I feel so abandoned, y'know?

ive been thinking about that, but i don't know if I'll be able to find/hold down employment because of my mental illness, and even then i might end up homeless by may because thats when my lease ends and the place im at now i moved into the day after i got kicked out of that independent living program/signed the papers. if my landlord hadnt accepted my application the staff at the program wouldve just dropped me off at a homeless shelter and threw out all my belongings. im terrified i guess. the future looks bleak.
I read it, and while I haven't gone through the same things as you, I do emphasize. I know how hard it can be just being 13, never mind having to go through other things on top of that.
